en-US.description: Run the upstream Docker Engine on Windows via WSL2, with no licence fees.
en-US.longDescription:
Skrog serves the real Docker Engine API on the named pipe docker.exe already
talks to, backed by upstream dockerd running in a WSL2 distro it owns. Compose,
Dev Containers, Testcontainers, buildx and the Docker CLI work unmodified,
because the thing answering is genuinely dockerd.

It is headless by design: no GUI, no Kubernetes, no tray ceremony, and no
licence fee. A supervisor starts the engine at logon, survives crashes,
`wsl --shutdown` and sleep/resume, and idle-stops the engine to return its RAM.
`skrog lock` pins the exact dockerd, containerd, runc and BuildKit commits so a
laptop and a CI runner install the same engine.

Installing this package places the skrog command on PATH. It does not provision
anything: run `skrog install` next to set up the engine, then `skrog start`.
Skrog does not install a docker CLI - use Docker Desktop's, or `skrog cli install`.
en-US.name: Skrog
